title: Dolomites, Italy: Tirolean Culture and Alpine Adventures - Rick Steves’ Europe Travel Guide
speaker: Rick Steves' Europe
zh: 【Rick Steves' Europe】義大利多洛米蒂山：蒂羅爾文化與高山探險 - Rick Steves 的歐洲旅遊指南（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: We're on our way to Italy's dramatic limestone rooftop.
cues.en: We're on our way to Italy's dramatic limestone rooftop.
cues.zh: 我們正在前往義大利引人注目的石灰岩屋頂的路上。

cues.text: The Dolomites, with their distinct and jagged peaks, offer some of the best Alpine thrills in Europe.
cues.en: The Dolomites, with their distinct and jagged peaks, offer some of the best Alpine thrills in Europe.
cues.zh: 多洛米蒂山脈擁有獨特且鋸齒狀的山峰，提供歐洲最好的阿爾卑斯山刺激體驗。

cues.text: And these mighty mountains seem to protect the traditional culture in the region's villages and bucolic farmsteads.
cues.en: And these mighty mountains seem to protect the traditional culture in the region's villages and bucolic farmsteads.
cues.zh: 這些雄偉的山脈似乎保護著該地區村莊和田園農莊的傳統文化。

cues.text: Historically, the Tirol was its own state.
cues.en: Historically, the Tirol was its own state.
cues.zh: 從歷史上看，蒂羅爾州是一個獨立的州。

cues.text: Today, that region is divided -- part in Austria and part in Italy.
cues.en: Today, that region is divided -- part in Austria and part in Italy.
cues.zh: 如今，該地區已被分裂——一部分屬於奧地利，一部分屬於義大利。

cues.text: The Italian part is called South Tirol.
cues.en: The Italian part is called South Tirol.
cues.zh: 義大利部分稱為南蒂羅爾。

cues.text: The region is a mix of the two cultures and officially bilingual.
cues.en: The region is a mix of the two cultures and officially bilingual.
cues.zh: 該地區是兩種文化的混合體，官方語言是雙語的。

cues.text: While the traditional economy is farming, today tourism is also big --
cues.en: While the traditional economy is farming, today tourism is also big --
cues.zh: 雖然傳統經濟是農業，但如今旅遊業也很重要——

cues.text: skiing in winter, hiking in summer.
cues.en: skiing in winter, hiking in summer.
cues.zh: 冬天滑雪，夏天健行。

cues.text: The Great Dolomite Road, beautifully engineered, leads to the nearly 7,000-foot-high Sela Pass.
cues.en: The Great Dolomite Road, beautifully engineered, leads to the nearly 7,000-foot-high Sela Pass.
cues.zh: 設計精美的大白雲石公路通往近 7,000 英尺高的沙拉山口。

cues.text: ♪♪ It's great for a joy ride, and famously a big challenge for bikers.
cues.en: ♪♪ It's great for a joy ride, and famously a big challenge for bikers.
cues.zh: ♪♪ 這非常適合享受騎乘樂趣，而且對騎腳踏車的人來說也是一個巨大的挑戰。

cues.text: Making it to the summit is always a good excuse for a triumphant group photo.
cues.en: Making it to the summit is always a good excuse for a triumphant group photo.
cues.zh: 登頂始終是拍攝勝利合照的好藉口。

cues.text: These bold limestone pillars offer something for everybody.
cues.en: These bold limestone pillars offer something for everybody.
cues.zh: 這些大膽的石灰石柱為每個人提供了一些東西。

cues.text: This is rock-climbing country -- thrilling, even for spectators.
cues.en: This is rock-climbing country -- thrilling, even for spectators.
cues.zh: 這是一個攀巖國家——即使對觀眾來說也是令人興奮的。

cues.text: ♪♪ From the town of Ortisei, we're catching the Seceda lift.
cues.en: ♪♪ From the town of Ortisei, we're catching the Seceda lift.
cues.zh: ♪♪ 從奧蒂塞伊鎮出發，我們搭乘 Seceda 纜車。

cues.text: All over this region, the lifts do the climbing fast and easy,
cues.en: All over this region, the lifts do the climbing fast and easy,
cues.zh: 在這個地區，電梯可以快速輕鬆地攀爬，

cues.text: depositing hikers sweat-free at thin-air trailheads.
cues.en: depositing hikers sweat-free at thin-air trailheads.
cues.zh: 將健行者無汗地安置在空氣稀薄的步道起點。

cues.text: I love walking on a ridge.
cues.en: I love walking on a ridge.
cues.zh: 我喜歡在山脊上行走。

cues.text: And with as many nationalities enjoying this scene as there are flowers in the fields,
cues.en: And with as many nationalities enjoying this scene as there are flowers in the fields,
cues.zh: 田野裡有鮮花，有多少民族都在欣賞這景象，

cues.text: the blissful world up here is one of pristine nature
cues.en: the blissful world up here is one of pristine nature
cues.zh: 這裡的幸福世界是原始的自然世界之一

cues.text: and happy hikers.
cues.en: and happy hikers.
cues.zh: 和快樂的徒步旅行者。

cues.text: These slopes are busy with skiers in the winter.
cues.en: These slopes are busy with skiers in the winter.
cues.zh: 冬天這些滑雪場擠滿了滑雪者。

cues.text: When planning, be aware that in early spring and late fall --
cues.en: When planning, be aware that in early spring and late fall --
cues.zh: 規劃時，請注意在早春和晚秋—

cues.text: that's between seasons here in the Dolomites -- many lifts, huts, and restaurants are shut down,
cues.en: that's between seasons here in the Dolomites -- many lifts, huts, and restaurants are shut down,
cues.zh: 那是在多洛米蒂山的季節之間——許多電梯、小屋和餐廳都關閉了，

cues.text: and trails can be covered in snow.
cues.en: and trails can be covered in snow.
cues.zh: 小徑可能會被雪覆蓋。

cues.text: We're here in summer, and everything's wide open.
cues.en: We're here in summer, and everything's wide open.
cues.zh: 我們來這裡是在夏天，一切都是開放的。

cues.text: Everywhere I look feels like an Alpine adventure awaiting my arrival.
cues.en: Everywhere I look feels like an Alpine adventure awaiting my arrival.
cues.zh: 我所看到的每一處都像是一場阿爾卑斯山探險在等待我的到來。

cues.text: ♪♪ One thing I love about Europe --
cues.en: ♪♪ One thing I love about Europe --
cues.zh: ♪♪ 我喜歡歐洲的一件事——

cues.text: I've been coming here all my life, and there's still places to discover.
cues.en: I've been coming here all my life, and there's still places to discover.
cues.zh: 我一生都來到這裡，但仍有地方值得探索。

cues.text: The town of Kastelruth feels like an Alpine village rather than a ski resort.
cues.en: The town of Kastelruth feels like an Alpine village rather than a ski resort.
cues.zh: 卡斯特魯斯鎮給人的感覺更像是阿爾卑斯山村莊，而不是滑雪勝地。

cues.text: That's why I feature it in my Italy guidebook as the ideal home base for exploring the Dolomites.
cues.en: That's why I feature it in my Italy guidebook as the ideal home base for exploring the Dolomites.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼我在我的義大利旅遊指南中將其列為探索多洛米蒂山脈的理想大本營。

cues.text: The hyperactive bell tower seems to ring out the wisdom of honoring local traditions.
cues.en: The hyperactive bell tower seems to ring out the wisdom of honoring local traditions.
cues.zh: 熱鬧非凡的鐘樓似乎在訴說著尊重當地傳統的智慧。

cues.text: Buildings are painted with murals celebrating the town's rich heritage.
cues.en: Buildings are painted with murals celebrating the town's rich heritage.
cues.zh: 建築物上塗有壁畫，頌揚鎮上豐富的遺產。

cues.text: ♪♪ Clearly, fire has long been a concern.
cues.en: ♪♪ Clearly, fire has long been a concern.
cues.zh: ♪♪ 顯然，火災長期以來一直是人們關注的問題。

cues.text: Saint Florian, the patron of firefighters, is shown all over town putting out fires.
cues.en: Saint Florian, the patron of firefighters, is shown all over town putting out fires.
cues.zh: 聖弗洛裡安（Saint Florian）是消防員的守護神，他在鎮上各處滅火。

cues.text: The town cemetery is like a lovingly tended garden.
cues.en: The town cemetery is like a lovingly tended garden.
cues.zh: 小鎮的墓園就像一個精心照料的花園。

cues.text: Entire families share a common plot.
cues.en: Entire families share a common plot.
cues.zh: 整個家庭都有一個共同的地盤。

cues.text: ♪♪ Cobbled lanes lead past friendly shops
cues.en: ♪♪ Cobbled lanes lead past friendly shops
cues.zh: ♪♪ 鵝卵石小巷經過友善的商店

cues.text: to the welcoming town square.
cues.en: to the welcoming town square.
cues.zh: 前往熱情的城鎮廣場。

cues.text: And for generations, the fountain, with its metal cup,
cues.en: And for generations, the fountain, with its metal cup,
cues.zh: 世世代代，噴泉及其金屬杯，

cues.text: has invited all for a refreshing drink.
cues.en: has invited all for a refreshing drink.
cues.zh: 邀請大家喝一杯清涼飲料。

cues.text: The fountain also watered horses, back when coaching inns lined the square.
cues.en: The fountain also watered horses, back when coaching inns lined the square.
cues.zh: 當馬車旅館遍佈廣場時，噴泉還可以給馬匹飲水。

cues.text: ♪♪ Here in the region of South Tirol,
cues.en: ♪♪ Here in the region of South Tirol,
cues.zh: ♪♪ 在南蒂羅爾地區，

cues.text: even though we're in Italy, locals speak German first and Italian second.
cues.en: even though we're in Italy, locals speak German first and Italian second.
cues.zh: 即使我們在義大利，當地人會先講德語，然後講義大利語。

cues.text: That's because for centuries it was in the Austrian Habsburg realm ruled from Vienna.
cues.en: That's because for centuries it was in the Austrian Habsburg realm ruled from Vienna.
cues.zh: 這是因為幾個世紀以來它一直處於維也納統治的奧地利哈布斯堡王朝的領土內。

cues.text: After World War I, South Tirol ended up as part of Italy.
cues.en: After World War I, South Tirol ended up as part of Italy.
cues.zh: 第一次世界大戰後，南蒂羅爾最終成為義大利的一部分。

cues.text: Mussolini did what he could to Italianize the region.
cues.en: Mussolini did what he could to Italianize the region.
cues.zh: 墨索里尼竭盡全力使該地區義大利化。

cues.text: He even gave each city a new Italian name.
cues.en: He even gave each city a new Italian name.
cues.zh: 他甚至為每個城市取了一個新的義大利名字。

cues.text: This town, Kastelruth, became Castelrotto.
cues.en: This town, Kastelruth, became Castelrotto.
cues.zh: 這個小鎮，卡斯特魯斯 (Kastelruth)，後來成為卡斯特羅託 (Castelrotto)。

cues.text: But the region's Germanic heritage endures.
cues.en: But the region's Germanic heritage endures.
cues.zh: 但該地區的日耳曼遺產依然存在。

cues.text: You can see it in its prosperity and in its lively folk culture.
cues.en: You can see it in its prosperity and in its lively folk culture.
cues.zh: 你可以從它的繁榮和熱鬧的民俗文化中看到它。

cues.text: Amateur folk bands have fun keeping that heritage alive.
cues.en: Amateur folk bands have fun keeping that heritage alive.
cues.zh: 業餘民謠樂團樂於保留這項傳統。

cues.text: The instruments are traditional, as are the costumes.
cues.en: The instruments are traditional, as are the costumes.
cues.zh: 樂器是傳統的，服裝也是傳統的。

cues.text: The blue aprons come from a time when humble workers needed to protect their precious clothing.
cues.en: The blue aprons come from a time when humble workers needed to protect their precious clothing.
cues.zh: 藍色圍裙來自卑微的工人需要保護他們珍貴的衣服的時代。

cues.text: ♪♪ It's nice to think that these boys
cues.en: ♪♪ It's nice to think that these boys
cues.zh: ♪♪ 很高興想到這些男孩

cues.text: are both modern and traditional, and their traditions are clearly
cues.en: are both modern and traditional, and their traditions are clearly
cues.zh: 既現代又傳統，而且他們的傳統很明顯

cues.text: surviving into the next generation.
cues.en: surviving into the next generation.
cues.zh: 生存到下一代。

cues.text: Whoo!
cues.en: Whoo!
cues.zh: 呼！

cues.text: Kastelruth is the gateway to Europe's largest Alpine meadow,
cues.en: Kastelruth is the gateway to Europe's largest Alpine meadow,
cues.zh: 卡斯特魯斯 (Kastelruth) 是通往歐洲最大高山草甸的門戶，

cues.text: the Alpe di Siusi.
cues.en: the Alpe di Siusi.
cues.zh: 阿爾卑斯休斯山。

cues.text: As automobiles are generally not allowed, visitors approach by cable car.
cues.en: As automobiles are generally not allowed, visitors approach by cable car.
cues.zh: 由於一般不允許汽車通行，遊客只能搭乘纜車前往。

cues.text: Landing at Compatsch, the commercial hub of the meadow, hikers can hop a lift or a shuttle bus
cues.en: Landing at Compatsch, the commercial hub of the meadow, hikers can hop a lift or a shuttle bus
cues.zh: 抵達草地商業中心 Compatsch 後，健行者可以搭乘電梯或穿梭巴士

cues.text: to the trailhead of their choice.
cues.en: to the trailhead of their choice.
cues.zh: 到他們選擇的起點。

cues.text: The Alpe di Siusi is a natural preserve at the foot of the mighty Sassolungo
cues.en: The Alpe di Siusi is a natural preserve at the foot of the mighty Sassolungo
cues.zh: Alpe di Siusi 是位於雄偉的 Sassolungo 腳下的自然保護區

cues.text: and Sasso Piatto peaks.
cues.en: and Sasso Piatto peaks.
cues.zh: 和薩索皮亞託峰。

cues.text: The meadow is 3 miles wide by 7 miles long, and seems to float at 6,000 feet above sea level.
cues.en: The meadow is 3 miles wide by 7 miles long, and seems to float at 6,000 feet above sea level.
cues.zh: 這片草地寬 3 英里，長 7 英里，似乎漂浮在海拔 6,000 英尺的地方。

cues.text: It's dotted by farm huts and wildflowers, surrounded by dramatic Dolomite peaks,
cues.en: It's dotted by farm huts and wildflowers, surrounded by dramatic Dolomite peaks,
cues.zh: 這裡點綴著農場小屋和野花，周圍環繞著雄偉的白雲石山峰，

cues.text: and crisscrossed by meadow trails -- ideal for equestrians, flower lovers, and walkers.
cues.en: and crisscrossed by meadow trails -- ideal for equestrians, flower lovers, and walkers.
cues.zh: 草地小徑縱橫交錯，非常適合馬術愛好者、花卉愛好者和步行者。

cues.text: It's also just right for someone needing a lazy beer with a spectacular view.
cues.en: It's also just right for someone needing a lazy beer with a spectacular view.
cues.zh: 對於那些需要一邊欣賞壯麗景色一邊悠閒地喝啤酒的人來說，這裡也很合適。

cues.text: And completing this storybook Dolomite setting, the spooky Mount Schlern, home of mythical witches,
cues.en: And completing this storybook Dolomite setting, the spooky Mount Schlern, home of mythical witches,
cues.zh: 完成這本故事書的白雲石背景，幽靈般的施勒恩山，神話女巫的故鄉，

cues.text: looks boldly into the haze of the Italian peninsula.
cues.en: looks boldly into the haze of the Italian peninsula.
cues.zh: 大膽地觀察義大利半島的陰霾。
